messages.text: I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Restored arrow-key navigation in [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:28) and wired it to cards. Each arrow moves one card in that direction; movement stops at board edges. Tab, Enter, and Space keep their existing behavior.

I didn’t run tests.
